content: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a member of the Jewish ruling council.
He came to Jesus at night and said, '
Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God.

content.text: For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.

content: Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.
How can a man be born when he is old?

content.text: Surely he cannot enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!
